items.title: Apple's factor profile remains balanced as mega-cap quality anchor
items.snippet: Apple's multi-factor composite ranks in the 67th percentile of its peer universe, with above-average quality and size scores offsetting middling momentum and value exposure.

items.title: AAPL short interest at 0.7% of float, near historic lows
items.snippet: Bearish positioning on Apple remains minimal, with short interest as a fraction of free float hovering near all-time lows and days-to-cover well under one trading session.

items.title: Apple's high market correlation makes it a bellwether for S&P 500 direction
items.snippet: With a market correlation of 0.82 and beta of 1.12, Apple continues to function as a macro proxy within large-cap tech, reflecting broad market sentiment more than idiosyncratic catalysts.
